name: print-letterhead
title: Print letterhead
description: The letterhead and running footer that appear only when a page is printed or saved as a PDF, with the site chrome taken off the paper.
docs: Render it once in your layout: <PrintLetterhead brand details url hideSelectors />. On screen it renders nothing. When printed it shows the letterhead (brand left, details right, a rule) and, in the bottom page margin of every page, a running footer: the address on the left and 'Printed <date> · Page 1 of 3' on the right. The footer is written into page margin boxes, outside the text area, so a list, a table or a paragraph can never print over it; Chromium prints margin boxes, and a browser without them prints no footer rather than one over the text. The stylesheet takes off navigation, the site header and footer (not those inside an article, main or section), dialogs, banners and anything marked data-print-hide, plus your hideSelectors; it removes backgrounds and shadows, prints the light palette in dark mode, writes the address after links inside the article (data-print-no-url opts out) and keeps headings and table rows whole. The date is written as printing starts, the only script. locale, timeZone and three labels translate the footer. Switch off the print dialog's own headers and footers to avoid doubles.
